title: Natural Language Processing with Amazon Comprehend [Hands-On]

cues.en: Hello my friends and welcome to this new hands on tutorial on natural language processing with Amazon Comprehend.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到使用 Amazon Comprehend 做自然語言處理的實作。

cues.en: Indeed, Amazon Comprehend is the AWS service to use whenever you're doing NLP, whether it is for sentiment analysis, or any other NLP task.
cues.zh: Comprehend 是 AWS 的 NLP 服務，可做情緒分析與其他自然語言任務。

cues.en: And speaking of which, this is exactly what we'll do in this short and sweet demo of Comprehend.
cues.zh: 這個簡短示範就會做情緒分析。

cues.en: So let's go into the search bar.
cues.zh: 到搜尋列。

cues.en: Let's enter comprehend, and here it is.
cues.zh: 輸入 Comprehend，就在這裡。

cues.en: Amazon Comprehend is the service to use to analyze unstructured text.
cues.zh: Amazon Comprehend 用來分析非結構化文字。

cues.en: Remember this quick thing for the exam, you also have Amazon Comprehend Medical, which is the same thing, an NLP service, but fully designed for medical data.
cues.zh: 考試記住，也有 Comprehend Medical，同樣是 NLP，但專為醫療資料設計。

cues.en: Okay, so let's go to Amazon Comprehend.
cues.zh: 進 Amazon Comprehend。

cues.en: Welcome to Amazon Comprehend Natural Language Processing, indeed, and Text Analytics.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到自然語言處理與文字分析服務。

cues.en: Amazon Comprehend is a natural language processing NLP service that uses machine learning to find insights and relationships in text.
cues.zh: 它使用機器學習，找文字中的洞見與關係。

cues.en: All right, so here we go, let's launch Amazon Comprehend.
cues.zh: 啟動 Amazon Comprehend。

cues.en: And indeed, Amazon Comprehend provides real-time analysis of your text, either with built-in models or with a custom model that you can bring from an endpoint.
cues.zh: 它可即時分析文字，使用內建模型，或從端點提供自訂模型。

cues.en: And we'll see what endpoints are in the next section on deployment.
cues.zh: 下一節部署會看端點。

cues.en: And then you provide your input data here while choosing your analysis type, that we just saw, either built in or custom from an endpoint.
cues.zh: 在這裡提供輸入，選分析類型，內建或端點的自訂模型。

cues.en: We're gonna keep built in, of course.
cues.zh: 當然保留內建。

cues.en: Here we have a sample text which, actually, contains two texts.
cues.zh: 範例其實有兩段。

cues.en: One here that is an email or a message sent to a customer to say that his credit card is gonna be debited of $24 to auto pay
cues.zh: 一段是給顧客的郵件或訊息，說信用卡會扣 24 美元，自動付款，

cues.en: for a service on the due date.
cues.zh: 在到期日支付服務費。

cues.en: And here we have customer feedback for a spa, okay?
cues.zh: 另一段是 SPA 顧客意見。

cues.en: But we're gonna clear this text, we're gonna play with new text and, of course, we're gonna take, again, our restaurant reviews, which you will find in your machinery model development
cues.zh: 但先清空，改用新的文字，當然再次使用餐廳評論，在 Machine Learning Model Development

cues.en: folder inside this CSV file, restaurant reviews.
cues.zh: 資料夾的 Restaurant Reviews 檔。

cues.en: So let's open it, I'm gonna open it with a text editor here.
cues.zh: 用文字編輯器打開。

cues.en: All right, perfect and we're gonna pick any, like, feel free to choose a number between 1 and how many, there were 1000 reviews, okay?
cues.zh: 很好，隨意選一則，可以選 1 到，總共有 1,000 則。

cues.en: So, okay, I'm gonna say a random number, for example, 436, 436, here it is.
cues.zh: 隨機說個數字，例如 436，就在這裡。

cues.en: We're gonna put this one.
cues.zh: 使用這則。

cues.en: "It was a huge awkward 1.5 lb piece of cow "that was 3/4, gristle and fat."
cues.zh: 「那是一大塊難以處理、重 1.5 磅的牛肉，其中四分之三都是筋與肥肉。」

cues.en: Okay, so I guess the review is negative here, so I'm gonna copy it and we're gonna analyze it, okay?
cues.zh: 我猜是負評，複製來分析。

cues.en: So back to Amazon Comprehend, I'm gonna copy it here.
cues.zh: 回 Comprehend，貼在這裡。

cues.en: All right, we can first analyze the text to see the real-time analysis of our review.
cues.zh: 先按 Analyze text，看即時分析。

cues.en: And so, as you can see, it classifies some words of the review with a confidence level as you can see.
cues.zh: 可以看到，會替某些詞分類，並顯示信心程度。

cues.en: So, for example, it's cut well that the 1.5 lb part of the review is a quantity with 98% confidence, okay?
cues.zh: 例如把 1.5 lb 正確辨識為數量，信心 98%。

cues.en: And same for the 3/4 gristle and fat piece of cow, okay?
cues.zh: 四分之三都是筋與肥肉，也有分析。

cues.en: So that's just the text analysis, but if we look at the insights, indeed, right here, insights and then sentiment, well, we will get Amazon Comprehend's analysis
cues.zh: 這只是文字分析，到 Insights，再到 Sentiment，就有

cues.en: of whether this review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 評論正面或負面的分析。

cues.en: So it says neutral with 5% confidence.
cues.zh: Neutral 信心 5%。

cues.en: That's quite true actually, the first time I read it, I wasn't sure, at least with the first part if it was positive or negative, but then when we saw the last part it was of course negative
cues.zh: 確實，第一次只看前面時，我不確定正負，但最後部分明顯負面，

cues.en: and Amazon Comprehend completely cut that, well, because it predicts that it is a negative review with 94% confidence, okay?
cues.zh: Comprehend 完全抓到了，預測 Negative，信心 94%。

cues.en: Let's pick another review.
cues.zh: 再選一則。

cues.en: All right, let's pick a random number.
cues.zh: 隨機數字。

cues.en: Let's say, for example, 328.
All right, there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Here's the review, "They could serve it "with just a vinegarette "and it may make for a better overall dish, "but it was still very good."
cues.zh: 「如果只搭配油醋醬，也許整道菜會更好，但仍然非常好吃。」

cues.en: So here it's actually quite easy, it's a positive review.
cues.zh: 這裡很容易，是正評。

cues.en: Okay so, it's gonna catch that with no issue.
cues.zh: 應該沒問題。

cues.en: Let's replace the review by the new one and analyze again.
cues.zh: 換成新評論，再分析。

cues.en: All right, analyzing and sentiment, it's, of course well, mixed.
cues.zh: 分析中，Sentiment，當然是，喔，Mixed。

cues.en: Okay yes, mixed is actually a better analysis because it said at the end, "but it was still very good," I consider it positive, but it's true that there is a little criticism here, right?
cues.zh: 對，Mixed 更合適，最後說仍然很好，我認為正面，但確實也有一些批評。

cues.en: So what the model says, you know, the NLP model says is that it's positive with 6% confidence and mixed review with 93% confidence,
cues.zh: NLP 模型說 Positive 信心 6%，Mixed 信心 93%，

cues.en: which makes sense because of that part of the review, which criticizes it a bit, okay?
cues.zh: 很合理，因為這段稍有批評。

cues.en: So that's it for this short and sweet demo of Amazon Comprehend.
cues.zh: 這就是 Comprehend 簡短示範。

cues.en: Remember, essentially, that it's the go-to service for NLP, natural language processing.
cues.zh: 主要記住，它是自然語言處理 NLP 的首選服務。

cues.en: I'll look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂實作見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
